expressions.name: max_month
expressions.expr: [x['month'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['units'] == max([y['units'] for y in extras['usage_history']])][0]

expressions.name: fpa_amount
expressions.expr: [c['amount'] for c in level1['charges'] if c['type'] == 'fpa'][0]

expressions.name: last_year_units
expressions.expr: [x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'APR-25'][0]

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: level1['units_consumed'] - [x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'APR-25'][0]

expressions.name: summer_avg
expressions.expr: sum([x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['JUN-25', 'JUL-25', 'AUG-25']])

expressions.name: winter_avg
expressions.expr: sum([x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['DEC-25', 'JAN-26', 'FEB-26']])

expressions.name: diff
expressions.expr: sum([x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['JUN-25', 'JUL-25', 'AUG-25']]) - sum([x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] in ['DEC-25', 'JAN-26', 'FEB-26']])

expressions.name: unpaid_bills
expressions.expr: [x for x in extras['billing_history_rows'] if x['amount_billed'] != x['amount_paid']]

expressions.name: same_month_last_year
expressions.expr: [x['units'] for x in extras['usage_history'] if x['month'] == 'APR-25'][0]

expressions.name: monthly_average_cost
expressions.expr: sum([x['amount_billed'] for x in extras['billing_history_rows']]) / len(extras['billing_history_rows'])

expressions.name: last_month_bill
expressions.expr: [x['amount_billed'] for x in extras['billing_history_rows'] if x['month'] == 'MAR-26'][0]
